cases.symptoms: Severe intractable nausea, epilation of scalp within 48h, absolute lymphocyte count 0.1 x 10^9/L, petechial hemorrhages on forearms.
cases.intervention: Bed rest on double wool mattress; oral Prussian Blue slurry (3g/day); boiled willow-bark tea for pain; isolated from drafts in lower clinic.
cases.outcome: Patient survived initial 30 days through extreme fluid replacement; persistent chronic bone marrow depression.
cases.doctor_margin_note: His eyes were yellow like old wax. He asked if the sky would ever be blue again. I lied and told him it would clear by Tuesday.

cases.symptoms: Bilateral chemical conjunctivitis and superficial corneal ulceration following exposure to acidic sulfur runoff mist at Canal Lock 1.
cases.intervention: Continuous irrigation with 2 liters of sterile boiled saline; castor oil eye drops; dark cloth eye patch for 72 hours.
cases.outcome: Corneal re-epithelialization complete by Day 15; mild photophobia persisting in snow glare.
cases.doctor_margin_note: A brave girl. She did not cry even when the saline burned her eyelids. She asked if her rifle was still dry.

cases.symptoms: Closed compound fracture of the left radius and ulna following cave-in of the lower excavation drift header beam.
cases.intervention: Closed reduction under local ethanol block; immobilization with splints carved from seasoned pine planks and linen bandages.
cases.outcome: Bony union achieved at 8 weeks with minor 5-degree angulation; grip strength restored to 90%.
cases.doctor_margin_note: Stepan bit down on an iron bolt while I set the bone. When it clicked into place, he spat blood and asked for a cigarette.

cases.symptoms: Fourth-degree frostbite of the left 4th and 5th digits following 14-hour blizzard crossing at -36°C; black necrotic dry gangrene.
cases.intervention: Disarticulation of the necrotic phalanges using curved surgical scissors and bone rasp; flap closure with silk suture; iodine paint.
cases.outcome: Clean primary wound healing; patient walks with slight limp on rough rock.
cases.doctor_margin_note: He apologized to me for bleeding on the clinic floor. I wanted to scream at the snow, but I saved his heel.

cases.symptoms: Second-degree partial-thickness scald burns over entire anterior chest and left shoulder from high-pressure boiler gasket rupture.
cases.intervention: Gentle debridement of devitalized blister epidermis; application of sterile mutton tallow and pine resin ointment; daily dressing changes.
cases.outcome: Epithelialization in 18 days; thick keloid scarring across pectoralis major.
cases.doctor_margin_note: Fyodor refused to leave his shift until the steam pressure dropped below five atmospheres. Stokers are made of pig iron.

cases.symptoms: Severe auditory hallucinations (hearing air-raid sirens and baby cries in the 50 Hz generator hum); 5 days total sleep deprivation.
cases.intervention: Hot chamomile and valerian root infusion; 6-hour acoustic isolation in lowest sound-baffled battery room; mandatory earplugs.
cases.outcome: Resolved after 14 hours uninterrupted sleep; cognitive faculties intact.
cases.doctor_margin_note: The diesel engine has rhythm, but the human mind searches for voices in the exhaust. We must keep the lamps burning.

cases.symptoms: Productive cough with rust-colored sputum, nocturnal pyrexia, severe cachexia, rales in right apical lung lobe.
cases.intervention: Strict quarantine in Old Battery Cubicle; daily steam inhalation with eucalyptus oil; high-calorie lard and dried mushroom broth.
cases.outcome: Chronic sputum conversion; patient restricted to surface dust-free tasks.
cases.doctor_margin_note: Bunk 3 is damp. If the ventilation fans fail for three hours, half the mining shift will be coughing blood by winter.

cases.symptoms: Punctate penetrating wound in right proximal thigh with localized arterial hematoma following landmine detonation at Sector 9.
cases.intervention: Exploratory incision under ether anesthesia; extraction of a 15mm jagged steel mortar casing fragment resting 2mm from femoral artery.
cases.outcome: Complete arterial preservation; wound healed by secondary intention with drainage tube.
cases.doctor_margin_note: My hands did not shake, but my knuckles were white for an hour afterwards. Two millimeters separated Ilya from eternity.

cases.symptoms: Severe abdominal colic ('painter's cramps'), peripheral motor neuropathy with bilateral wrist drop, characteristic blue Burton's line on gingiva.
cases.intervention: Chelation therapy using oral calcium disodium versenate (prepared from chemical stores); sulfur baths; mandatory gloves at scale.
cases.outcome: Colic resolved within 10 days; peripheral nerve function returned slowly over 4 months.
cases.doctor_margin_note: Harlan was biting pre-war lead solder wire to test purity. I struck his hand with a wooden tongue depressor. Greed makes men foolish.

cases.symptoms: Severe watery mucoid diarrhea, fontanelle depression, skin turgor loss, lethargy following consumption of unboiled condenser runoff.
cases.intervention: Immediate oral rehydration therapy with sterile boiled water, glucose, and pinch of salt; activated charcoal suspension.
cases.outcome: Full recovery within 48 hours; nursery protocol updated to mandate triple-boiled water.
cases.doctor_margin_note: Her little fingers curled around my thumb. When she drank the rehydration broth, I wept in the pantry.

cases.symptoms: Cherry-red skin pigmentation, severe throbbing frontal headache, syncope, carboxyhemoglobin level estimated at 40% from unvented coal brazier.
cases.intervention: Hyper-oxygenation using hand-pumped bellows connected to oxygen cylinder for 2 hours; forced fluid intake.
cases.outcome: Consciousness regained after 40 minutes; no residual neurological deficits.
cases.doctor_margin_note: The cold drives men to foolish braziers. If we don't fix the thermal ducts, we will bury more dwellers from smoke than from fallout.

cases.symptoms: Rapidly enlarging 3cm hard nodule in right thyroid lobe, hoarseness from recurrent laryngeal nerve compression; history of drinking I-131 water on Day 1.
cases.intervention: Fine-needle aspiration biopsy confirming papillary thyroid carcinoma; daily administration of stable potassium iodide to saturate gland.
cases.outcome: Tumor growth arrested; surgical hemi-thyroidectomy planned when sterile field can be established.
cases.doctor_margin_note: The harvest of Iodine-131 begins. Boris laughed and baked three loaves of bread after the needle biopsy. He is stronger than I am.

cases.symptoms: Depressed compound parietal skull fracture from falling granite boulder in Tunnel 4; anisocoria, comatose with GCS 6.
cases.intervention: Emergency cranial trepanation using sterilized brace and hand drill; elevation of bone fragments; evacuation of 30ml epidural hematoma.
cases.outcome: Pupillary symmetry restored on operating table; regained consciousness on Day 312 with mild expressive aphasia.
cases.doctor_margin_note: The sound of the drill bit piercing the skull plate will haunt me until I die. Grigory woke up and asked if the bridge was down.

cases.symptoms: Spongy bleeding gums, corkscrew hair folicles, subperiosteal hematomas on tibias, profound fatigue and opening of old scar tissue.
cases.intervention: Administration of freshly brewed pine needle infusion (rich in ascorbic acid); 100g sprouted dried peas per day.
cases.outcome: Gingival bleeding ceased in 5 days; scar integrity restored within 2 weeks.
cases.doctor_margin_note: Green things are not a luxury; they are the glue that holds human flesh together. Elena's sprouted peas saved six lives today.

cases.symptoms: Persistent non-productive cough, exertional dyspnea, hemoglobin 8.5 g/dL, persistent leukopenia (WBC 2.4 x 10^9/L), radiation pneumonitis.
cases.intervention: Self-administered codeine syrup for cough; 200mg prednisone daily taper; training young Sonya in surgical knot tying.
cases.outcome: Progressive pulmonary fibrosis with chronic hypoxia; life expectancy estimated at 12–18 months.
cases.doctor_margin_note: I know my own chart. The chest X-ray plate would look like frosted glass. Sonya tied three square knots with her left hand today without dropping the needle. She will be ready.

cases.symptoms: Severe acute stridor, laryngeal spasm, pulmonary edema following failure of respirator exhaust valve during pH 2.8 sulfuric acid squall.
cases.intervention: Emergency cricothyroidotomy using large-bore trocar cannula; positive pressure oxygen ventilation; nebulized sodium bicarbonate solution.
cases.outcome: Laryngeal swelling subsided in 72 hours; cannula removed on Day 414.
cases.doctor_margin_note: Sonya held the thyroid cartilage while I made the incision. Her fingers were steady as stone. Mikhail can speak again.

cases.symptoms: Bilateral periorbital edema, severe generalized myalgia, splinter hemorrhages under fingernails, eosinophilia 35% after eating uninspected wild smoked pork.
cases.intervention: High-dose oral thiabendazole compound from pre-war veterinary kit; corticosteroid anti-inflammatory therapy.
cases.outcome: Parasite encystment controlled; myalgia subsided over 6 weeks.
cases.doctor_margin_note: Wild meat must be boiled for ninety minutes, no matter how hungry the scouts are. I gave Karp a lecture that hurt worse than the worms.

cases.symptoms: Severe joint pain in right elbow ('the bends'), cutaneous cutis marmorata, mild vertigo following rapid emergency ascent from 14-meter canal dive.
cases.intervention: Immediate recompression in improvised steel pressure tank at 2.5 atmospheres breathing pure oxygen for 4 hours; IV saline hydration.
cases.outcome: Complete symptom resolution; no residual neurological deficits; diving cleared after 14 days rest.
cases.doctor_margin_note: I wanted to lock her in her bunk. But who else can weld the intake grates beneath four fathoms of black water? I made her promise never to skip the 3-meter safety stop.

cases.symptoms: Total opacity of right lens following infrared furnace exposure and flying anvil spark; visual acuity reduced to light perception.
cases.intervention: Extracapsular cataract extraction performed through 6mm corneal incision; anterior capsulotomy using cystotome needle; aphakic corrective spectacles provided.
cases.outcome: Visual acuity restored to 20/40 with +10 diopter lens; returned to master forging duties.
cases.doctor_margin_note: Operating on an eye by candlelight is madness. But Oleg can see the color of the forge fire again. He forged me a surgical retractor out of nickel as thanks.

cases.symptoms: End-stage radiation pulmonary fibrosis, Cheyne-Stokes breathing, profound cachexia, cyanosis of nail beds, sensorium fading.
cases.intervention: Palliative comfort care: sips of boiled sugar water, willow-bark infusion, moist linen cloth on forehead; hand held during 31-name triage recitation.
cases.outcome: Passed peacefully at 04:18 on Day 620 surrounded by Sonya, Anton, and Sister Mara.
cases.doctor_margin_note: [Written by Sonya]: She spoke thirty-one names from the first forty-five days. When she reached the thirty-second name, she touched my hand and whispered: 'You take the book now, Sonya.' I will not let her down.

cases.symptoms: Severe right lower quadrant rebound tenderness (McBurney's point positive), pyrexia 39.2°C, leukocytosis, acute gangrenous appendicitis.
cases.intervention: Emergency McBurney muscle-splitting appendectomy; purse-string ligation of appendix base; peritoneal lavage with sterile saline.
cases.outcome: Complete primary recovery; ambulatory on post-op day 4; full return to masonry labor.
cases.doctor_margin_note: My first solo surgery without Dr. Vel standing beside me. I heard her voice in my ear telling me where to place the second clamp. The patient is alive.

cases.symptoms: Heavy chemical bronchial burning, hemoptysis, dry cough after unsealed radon pocket breached in lowest limestone strata (-50m).
cases.intervention: Immediate evacuation to surface clean air; administration of aerosolized glutathione and potassium iodide; high-pressure duct ventilation.
cases.outcome: Pulmonary inflammation resolved over 3 weeks; deep drift sealed with clay bulkhead.
cases.doctor_margin_note: The earth has its own poisons older than the bombs. We must test every rock pocket with the alpha detector before picking.

cases.symptoms: Almond odor on breath, acute dyspnea, confusion, bright red retinal veins following inadvertent acid-cyanide reaction in gold extraction vat.
cases.intervention: Immediate inhalation of amyl nitrite pearls; IV administration of 12.5g sodium thiosulfate from emergency poison kit.
cases.outcome: Rapid cellular oxygenation restored within 15 minutes; fully conscious with mild headache.
cases.doctor_margin_note: Ilya's hands were blue when they carried him in. The thiosulfate worked like a miracle. Science is our shield.

cases.symptoms: Central cyanosis during feeding, grade 4/6 pansystolic heart murmur at left sternal border; ventricular septal defect.
cases.intervention: Conservative medical management: elevated feeding position, small volume concentrated feedings, digitalis leaf extract titration.
cases.outcome: Spontaneous functional closure of defect by Month 14; normal developmental milestones.
cases.doctor_margin_note: His mother sat by the incubator for forty nights. Human love is a metabolic factor that no textbook can measure.

cases.symptoms: Progressive exertional dyspnea, jet-black sputum production ('melanoptysis'), forced vital capacity reduced to 45%.
cases.intervention: Permanent transfer from boiler room to greenhouse sorting; daily chest physiotherapy and bronchodilator steam.
cases.outcome: Stabilization of pulmonary decline; quality of life improved in humid greenhouse atmosphere.
cases.doctor_margin_note: Ten years of shovel dust. When Petro smelled the tomato plants in the greenhouse, he smiled for the first time in five years.

cases.symptoms: Clean guillotine amputation of the right index finger at the proximal interphalangeal joint by circular saw blade.
cases.intervention: Microvascular bone fixation with Kirschner wire; tendon repair using 6-0 monofilament; microscopic nerve and vessel anastomosis.
cases.outcome: Successful graft revascularization; 70% active flexion recovered at 6 months.
cases.doctor_margin_note: I used the Swiss watchmaker's tweezers and the 8x jeweler's loupe. Mikhail can carve wooden spoons again.

cases.symptoms: Raindrop pigmentation of trunk skin, palmoplantar keratoses, peripheral sensory neuropathy from drinking unmonitored mine runoff.
cases.intervention: Installation of ferric hydroxide sand filter; oral administration of dimercaprol (BAL); source water redirected to deep well.
cases.outcome: Urinary arsenic cleared within 3 weeks; dermatological lesions regressed over 6 months.
cases.doctor_margin_note: Water is life, but unpurified water is a slow executioner. We built two new sand filtration beds today.

cases.symptoms: Obstructed labor, cephalopelvic disproportion, fetal bradycardia (heart rate 85 bpm) after 26 hours of active labor.
cases.intervention: Lower segment transverse Cesarean section under spinal ethanol anesthesia; delivery of 3.8kg male infant; uterine closure.
cases.outcome: Both mother and newborn thriving; infant cried immediately upon suctioning.
cases.doctor_margin_note: Dmitri named him Dmitri Junior. He built me a stainless steel instrument tray as a thank-you gift.

cases.symptoms: Bilateral photokeratitis and temporary scotoma following molten slag explosion at the Silent Foundry without cobalt safety visor.
cases.intervention: Topical antibiotic ointment, homatropine cycloplegic drops, cold compress therapy in total darkness for 48 hours.
cases.outcome: Visual fields fully restored; mandatory cobalt glass shields enforced on foundry floor.
cases.doctor_margin_note: Production quotas cannot justify blinding workers. I made the Foundry Master sign a safety mandate.

cases.symptoms: Routine 5-year post-exposure examination. Hemoglobin 13.8 g/dL, Platelets 220 x 10^9/L, WBC 6.2 x 10^9/L.
cases.intervention: Bone marrow biopsy confirming complete trilineage hematopoietic reconstitution with normal cellularity.
cases.outcome: Full clinical recovery from a lethal 4.2 Sv exposure; working as head of the Valley Seed Archive.
cases.doctor_margin_note: Victor walked into the clinic with a basket of fresh greenhouse apples. Five years ago, Dr. Vel and I thought he had three days to live. The human body is miraculous.

cases.symptoms: Bilateral immersion foot (trench foot) with severe erythema, burning paresthesias, and macerated plantar skin from 10 days in flooded trench.
cases.intervention: Warm air drying, daily application of sulfur-zinc paste, wool sock rotation protocol, gentle progressive weight-bearing.
cases.outcome: Skin re-epithelialized; nerve sensation fully returned after 4 weeks.
cases.doctor_margin_note: Dry socks save more feet than scalpel blades. I ordered forty pairs of double-knit wool socks from the weavers.

cases.symptoms: Chronic fungal rhinosinusitis, facial pain, dark nasal discharge from sorting water-damaged paper in Archive Vault 2.
cases.intervention: Sinus lavage with dilute saline and tea tree oil extract; ventilation dehumidifier installation; archives irradiated with UV lamps.
cases.outcome: Sinus clearance achieved; archive air quality restored to safe levels.
cases.doctor_margin_note: Old books must be preserved, but not at the cost of young lungs. We sun-dried four hundred volumes on the upper deck.

cases.symptoms: Severe periapical abscess of lower first molar causing facial cellulitis and trismus.
cases.intervention: Tooth extraction under mental nerve block; drainage of abscess; fabrication of carved bone partial dental bridge.
cases.outcome: Infection resolved completely; chewing function restored with carved bone prosthesis.
cases.doctor_margin_note: Lev can chew hard rye bread again. He made me a pair of supple goatskin surgical slippers in return.

cases.symptoms: Diabetic ketoacidosis (Kussmaul breathing, blood glucose > 25 mmol/L, ketonuria) following exhaustion of pre-war insulin vials.
cases.intervention: Emergency administration of freshly isolated porcine pancreatic insulin extracted and purified in the Silent Foundry laboratory.
cases.outcome: Acidosis resolved within 8 hours; continuous weekly insulin supply established for 4 diabetic dwellers.
cases.doctor_margin_note: Ilya and I worked forty-eight hours without sleep to extract the insulin. When Daria woke up and asked for milk, Ilya sat on the floor and cried.

cases.symptoms: First-degree sunburn on faces and shoulders after spending 3 hours in open sunlight without protective brimmed hats.
cases.intervention: Application of cooling aloe vera and calendula salve; gradual sun exposure schedule (30 mins/day increasing by 15 mins).
cases.outcome: Normal melanin pigmentation developed; zero dwellers suffered blistering.
cases.doctor_margin_note: Sunburn! A disease of the daylight! Ten years of treating frostbite and gamma burns, and today I treated children for sunburn! I laughed all afternoon.

cases.symptoms: Large central perforation of left tympanic membrane from 1982 airlock blast pressure wave; 40 dB conductive hearing loss.
cases.intervention: Underlay myringoplasty using temporalis fascia graft harvested through retroauricular incision; Gelfoam packing.
cases.outcome: Graft fully integrated; hearing threshold restored to within 10 dB of normal.
cases.doctor_margin_note: Taras put on the radio headphones and heard the violin waltz on 104.7 MHz with both ears for the first time in twelve years.

cases.symptoms: Right transtibial amputation stump with mature conical end-bearing pad.
cases.intervention: Fitting of custom spring-loaded titanium articulating prosthetic leg fabricated from salvaged helicopter rotor titanium.
cases.outcome: Patient achieved independent unassisted ambulation; able to hike 10 km on rough mountain trails.
cases.doctor_margin_note: Karp walked to the top of the south ridge on his new leg and stood there for two hours looking at the valley.

cases.symptoms: Widespread seasonal allergic rhinitis, sneezing, and ocular pruritus following the blooming of three million wild mountain dandelions.
cases.intervention: Oral quercetin extract; nasal saline rinses; distribution of light linen dust masks for meadow workers.
cases.outcome: Full community acclimatization to natural floral allergens.
cases.doctor_margin_note: Sneezing from flowers instead of choking on coal dust! May all our diseases be this gentle from now on.

cases.symptoms: 5-year disease-free survival following surgical excision of basal cell skin carcinoma; normal systemic organ function.
cases.intervention: Final oncology clearance; discharge from inpatient clinic; official closing of the Subterranean Radiation Ward.
cases.outcome: Ward permanently converted into the Valley Botanical Seed Library.
cases.doctor_margin_note: The oncology ward is empty. The last bed has been folded. We moved Elena's seed boxes into Room 4.

cases.attending_physician: Doctor Sonya, Chief Physician of Tessarat
cases.patient_name: The People of the Valley of Tessarat
cases.symptoms: General health: Robust. Population: 1,420 living souls. Epidemics: 0. Starvation cases: 0. Hope index: 100%.
cases.intervention: Preservation of Dr. Irina Vel's medical records in the granite archives; decommissioning of underground clinic in favor of the Sun Meadow Hospital.
cases.outcome: Life goes on in the daylight.
cases.doctor_margin_note: Dr. Vel: We treated forty cases in this book, and fourteen hundred people are alive to harvest the apples today. The book is closed. Rest well, Irina. We are whole.
